hooks.command: if ! command -v beans >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "beans is not installed. Run: brew install thoras-ai/tap/beans"; elif beans version | grep -q "thoras-ai/beans"; then beans prime; else echo "This beans binary is not the Thoras build and cannot read this repo's decisions. Do not use it. Ask the user to replace hmans/beans: https://github.com/thoras-ai/beans#installation"; fi
if command -v beans >/dev/null 2>&1 && beans version | grep -q "thoras-ai/beans"; then beans prime; fi
